3.1. Dumping a Store

A store can be copied while it is running.

3.1. Dumping a Store

Write the whole store to one file:

$ shelfdump --all > store.dump

Note

The dump holds data and settings, not log files.

Read it back with:

shelf --restore store.dump
	--verify

Warning

Restoring replaces every record in the target store.
